  "scientific_question": "Do donors with more CA1 pyramidal neurons in reactive-astrocyte neighborhoods that lack nearby oligodendrocytes show faster memory decline beyond the current CA1 neuron-loss and reactive-niche panel?",
  "approach": "Assign cells to CA1, then identify CA1 Pyramidal Neuron, Reactive Astrocyte, and Oligodendrocyte labels. For each CA1 pyramidal neuron, query CA1 neighbors within radius r using centroid distance, excluding the focal cell. Mark the neuron as reactive-exposed if it has at least one Reactive Astrocyte neighbor. The donor biomarker is the fraction of reactive-exposed CA1 pyramidal neurons that have zero Oligodendrocyte neighbors within the same radius. If a donor has CA1 pyramidal neurons but none are reactive-exposed, return 0.0; if CA1 pyramidal neurons are absent, return NaN.",

  "rationale": "Recent rounds consistently improved the panel by sharpening a CA1 reactive astrocyte\u2013pyramidal injury niche, and round 7 showed that pyramidal atrophy inside that niche was especially informative.
